name: Biology Wing
narrativeOnEnter: The biology wing reeks of chemicals and something worse. Sample racks, overturned microscopes, a dead centrifuge. Whoever worked here left in a panic. A specimen vault sits in the corner — still locked.

action.text:
SPECIMEN LOG — DR. REEVES

Sample B-7 shows accelerated cellular growth well beyond projections. Cross-contamination with Batch C is highly probable.

Director Harkins has ordered remote lockdown of the specimen vault and his office. His personal safe override:
{{director-safe-code}}

Do NOT leave this note in the fridge. Seriously, K.

hotspots.label: Maintenance Key Box
hotspots.lockedMessage: The key box is magnetically sealed — must be linked to the vault sequence lock.

action.text:
A high-power fluorescence microscope. The slide still in place shows something deeply wrong. The cells are hexagonal — almost crystalline. Nothing organic grows like this.

A sticky note on the eyepiece reads:
'DO NOT LOOK DIRECTLY. WEAR GOGGLES AT ALL TIMES.
— Dr. Chen'

ARCADIA RESEARCH — INTERNAL INCIDENT REPORT #41

Date: [REDACTED]
Incident: Uncontrolled replication event — Bio Wing B.
Containment status: PARTIAL.
Facility lockdown: AUTHORISED.

Personnel status:
— Dr. Reeves: Evacuated (verified)
— Dr. Chen: Location UNKNOWN
— Lab Technician K: [REDACTED]

Note appended by Director Harkins:
'Do not discuss with external parties under any circumstances. This file is sealed.'
